action_cards.action_title: Check food benefits: Sacramento County Department of Human Assistance (DHA), CalFresh
action_cards.reason: This program may be relevant to your situation because it provides ongoing help buying food.
action_cards.next_step: Contact the provider or apply through the official site. They decide eligibility based on your household. Apply by phone: 1-800-560-0976 (checked Oct 21).
action_cards.priority_reason: Benefits take time to process, so starting now helps.
action_cards.processing_estimate: Eligible households that complete the initial application process must be given an opportunity to participate as soon as possible, but not later than 30 calendar days after the application was filed (CalFresh Manual of Policies and Procedures, Division 63, Sections 63-300 to 63-301). In emergency situations, Expedited CalFresh benefits may be received no later than the 3rd calendar day after the application is filed (Saturday and Sunday count as 1 day).

action_cards.action_title: Apply for unemployment benefits: California Employment Development Department (EDD), Unemployment Insurance (UI)
action_cards.reason: This program may be relevant to your situation because it can replace part of lost wages after a layoff.
action_cards.next_step: Start the online application. Have your last employer's details and last day worked ready. UI phone line (English and Spanish): 1-800-300-5616, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. (checked Oct 22).
action_cards.priority_reason: Income replacement supports your other needs, and payments take time to start, so file early.
action_cards.processing_estimate: It takes about three weeks to process a benefit application and make the first payment.

contacts.label: How to apply
contacts.value: Apply online through myEDD (UI Online), which EDD describes as the fastest and most convenient way to apply for unemployment and manage a claim.
